claims: Usher and Chris Brown have officially announced "The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") for 2026.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") is a 33-date co-headlining stadium run across North America.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") begins June 26, 2026, in Denver.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") runs through December 11, 2026, in Tampa.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") stops in Los Angeles.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") stops in Chicago.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") stops in Toronto.
"The R&B Tour" (or "Raymond & Brown Tour") stops in Miami.
